Superior Room Pullman Tbilisi Hotel
SUPERIOR ROOM
SUPERIOR ROOM
BOOK
Relax and unwind away from home in the heart of the city. The sweeping views from the upper floors enhance this perfect sanctuary. Ideal for global nomads and spirited explorers,
our contemporary, comfortable Superior Rooms offer a King bed or two singles
and a walk-in rain shower.

Junior Suite Pullman Tbilisi Hotel
JUNIOR SUITE
JUNIOR SUITE
BOOK
With guaranteed views over Tbilisi City, our Junior Suites positioned on the hotel's top floors will make you feel like you're in the heart of it all. Perfect for those who need a little more space, generously set bedroom, with plush sofa bed and a dining table, our Junior Suites will take your stay up a level.
